messages:
anya: Quick sync — I have a small PR that must land before the DB blackout at 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC (db team). It only touches a feature flag migration. CI is mostly green but mac e2e is flaky. Can someone with mac matrix quota rerun or bump priority? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
liam: I can try a rerun, give me the PR link and SHA.
anya: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/pulls/21904  SHA: 7f3b2c1. Rebase done this morning. Failing on `mac-e2e-14` with a timeout in the smoke test.
maya: I have a mac quota slot free in ~20m. If we can reproduce locally I can eyeball logs.
noah: Heads up — ops scheduled DB blackout for cluster-us-east-1 at 02:00 UTC, can we aim to land by 01:30 to give rollback buffer? :+1:
anya: Yep 01:30 target works. If mac matrix doesn't clear, proposal: skip mac canary and land behind the --feature-flag toggle, then enable after blackout window? Thoughts?
liam: Skipping canary is risky unless we have an automatic rollback. Do we have a kill-switch?
ops-oncall: ops-oncall: we can extend the rollback window but prefer no schema changes during blackout. If this is feature-flag-only, it's ok to land with the flag off. We'll monitor.
sre-bot: CI note: bumped job priority for PR 21904, queued rerun on mac matrix. ETA ~12m.
maya: Reproduced the timeout locally — small flake in `session-init` when run with `--parallel 4`. Pushing a tiny retry patch now to reduce flakiness.
anya: Thanks maya. I'll hold the merge until rerun completes. If rerun still flaky, I'll open an admin request to land with flag off.
noah: If it helps, we can run a quick canary on a single ded instance after merge (manual smoke) and keep traffic off.
liam: Sounds good. @maya ping me when test passes and I'll do final approve+merge.
anya: Plan: wait for rerun -> if green, liam merges -> monitor canary on noah's step -> if rerun fails, land with flag off + ops monitoring. ETA to decide: 12m. Thanks all :rocket:
ops-oncall: I'll standby for monitoring and will post status to #incidents if anything odd shows up.
root_message_excerpt: Quick sync — I have a small PR that must land before the DB blackout at 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC (db team). Blocked by flaky mac e2e. Who can rerun or bump priority?
